key.name: poll-interval
key.summary: Status poll interval (seconds)
key.description: How often the extension calls `tailscale status --json` to refresh its UI. Lower values feel snappier but slightly increase CPU/wakeups.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the panel indicator icon
key.description: If true, a small Tailscale icon appears next to the Wi-Fi indicator while Tailscale is connected.

key.name: exit-node-indicator-color
key.summary: Colour of the exit node warning icon
key.description: Six-digit hex colour applied to the panel warning icon, e.g. "#e6b800". Anything that is not a #rrggbb literal is ignored and the default amber is used instead.

key.name: exit-node-active-indicator-color
key.summary: Colour of the exit node active icon
key.description: Six-digit hex colour applied to the panel icon shown while an exit node is routing, e.g. "#8ab4f8". Empty — the default — leaves the icon in whatever colour the panel gives it, which is what makes it follow a light or dark theme. Anything that is not a #rrggbb literal is treated as empty.

key.name: show-exit-node-active-indicator
key.summary: Show the exit node active icon in the panel
key.description: If true, a VPN icon appears in the panel while an exit node is selected and routing. Independent of show-indicator and of show-exit-node-indicator, which reports the opposite state.

key.name: show-exit-node-indicator
key.summary: Show the exit node warning icon in the panel
key.description: If true, a warning icon appears in the panel while an exit node is selected but cannot route, which is when the device has no internet access. Independent of show-indicator.

key.name: tailscale-binary
key.summary: Path to the tailscale CLI binary
key.description: Override if `tailscale` is not on PATH for the user running gnome-shell.

key.name: shortcut-toggle-tailscale
key.summary: Shortcut: connect / disconnect Tailscale

key.name: shortcut-toggle-exit-node
key.summary: Shortcut: toggle automatic exit node

key.name: shortcut-show-menu
key.summary: Shortcut: open the Tailscale quick settings menu

key.name: shortcut-open-admin-panel
key.summary: Shortcut: open the Tailscale admin console in a browser

key.name: shortcut-send-file
key.summary: Shortcut: send files via Taildrop

key.name: shortcut-add-funnel
key.summary: Shortcut: open the Add funnel dialog

key.name: taildrop-accept
key.summary: Accept incoming Taildrop files
key.description: When enabled, `tailscale file get --loop` runs in the background and writes incoming files to the inbox directory.

key.name: taildrop-inbox
key.summary: Directory where Taildrop files are saved

key.name: feature-taildrop-available
key.summary: Mirror: Taildrop usable on this tailnet
key.description: Written by the extension from the capability map in every `status --json` poll, so it tracks the tailnet's ACL on its own. Nothing reads it to decide what the menu shows — that comes off the same snapshot directly. It exists for the two consumers that cannot see a snapshot: the preferences window, which runs in its own process, and the Taildrop receiver, which is driven from GSettings.

key.name: feature-funnels-available
key.summary: Mirror: Funnel enabled for this tailnet
key.description: Written by the extension from the capability map in every `status --json` poll, so it tracks the tailnet's ACL on its own. Read by the preferences window, which runs in its own process and cannot see the snapshot the menu itself gates on.

key.name: min-pending-duration
key.summary: Minimum pending duration (milliseconds)
key.description: Floor the pending state stays visible before transitioning to the result, so instant operations don't flash. 0 disables the floor. How long the finished banner then stays on screen is GNOME's own timeout, which this extension does not set.

key.name: notify-connection
key.summary: Notify about connecting and disconnecting

key.name: notify-account
key.summary: Notify about login, logout and operator changes

key.name: notify-profile-switch
key.summary: Notify when a different profile is applied

key.name: notify-exit-node
key.summary: Notify about exit-node selection and availability

key.name: notify-network
key.summary: Notify about Magic DNS, routes, shields, SSH and LAN access

key.name: notify-taildrop
key.summary: Notify about Taildrop transfers and the receiver

key.name: notify-funnel
key.summary: Notify about Funnel ports

key.name: notify-errors
key.summary: Let failures through even when their category is off
key.description: Acts as a safety net rather than a category of its own: muting Taildrop hides its successes but not its failures. Turning this off as well produces total silence.

key.name: notify-misc
key.summary: Notify about clipboard copies and manual refreshes
